messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

Gruß

Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH,

Thank you for your offer, which we have compared with the other offers we hold for this part.

Your defect rate over the last four quarters stands at 1863 ppm (sc:70210@2026Q3). German producer prices for electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).

We are weighing several offers for this part; the options below would make yours the one we choose. A competing supplier has offered EUR 31.50 per unit (offer:70240-0).

We propose: EUR 27.00 per unit, payment 60 days net, lead time 35 days.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We would like to work with you and look forward to an offer we can compare favourably.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and rival quote and quality record data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. 

Hallo, I checked your numbers and the other quote, so I'm coming down to €30.50. Our current offer is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. What kind of volume are we talking about here? Which volume can you commit to? 

Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We can accept your terms and await your order. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. Hallo, 35 days is the shortest lead time we can run, and there is no cheaper material variant for this shaft. Let's lock this in with 30 days payment and 35 days lead time. We have free capacity for your parts. Our offer is a price of €28.65 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
